shortdesc.ph: Blur intensity of custom background images.
The degree of blurring applied to the custom background image.

plentry.pd: (1): Applies a low level of blur to the custom background image, allowing users to see the background clearly.
(2): Applies a medium level of blur to the custom background image, making it difficult for users to recognize background details.
(3): (Default) Applies a high level of blur to the custom background image, making it nearly impossible for users to distinguish background features.
1: The degree of blurring applied to the custom background image is low. The user can almost see the background clearly.
2: The degree of blurring applied to the custom background image is medium. It is difficult for the user to recognize details in the background.
3: (Default) The degree of blurring applied to the custom background image is high. The user can barely see any distinguishing features in the background.
